text: The boundaries between the low-error plateau (LEP), approximate power-law region (APL), and high-error plateau (HEP) depend on whether the physical phase of the target Hamiltonian is the TFIM ferromagnet, the critical point, or the paramagnet.

In shallow depth $d=1$ feed-forward neural networks (FFNNs) approximating the ground state of the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) at the critical transverse field $\kappa=\kappa_{c}$, there is a sharp transition at a critical parameter density $\rho_{c}\approx 3\text{--}5$ characterized by a rapid drop in fidelity $F(\rho)=\langle\Psi^{NN}(\rho)|\Psi^{NN}(\rho+\epsilon)\rangle$, a kink in the variational energy (discontinuity in $\mathrm{d}E/\mathrm{d}\rho$), and abrupt changes in the total magnetization in the $x$-direction and the total magnetization in the $z$-direction.
